title: Cataloging the Arcane
description: A necromancy tome has been sitting on an open shelf. Any visitor could have reached it, and I would rather nobody learn how long it sat there. Shelve the cases, then get it into the vault.

objectives.description: Shelve five cases of the Athenaeum's texts
objectives.notes: Interact with 5 different bookshelves to organize them

objectives.description: Find the necromancy tome on the open shelf
Get the tome into the restricted vault
Tell Elara where it was sitting

notes: Threat: a necromancy tome sitting unsecured where any visitor - patron or rival Magister - could have found it first. Giver motive: a misfiled forbidden text is Elara's mistake, and finding it before somebody else does is the only way it never becomes one. Consequence: unwired - the quest never lets the tome actually be found by anyone but the player, so the exposure it threatens never lands; a later pass could make failing this in time cost Elara a council rebuke. Second quest, Novice rank. PREREQUISITE FIX: the value in `prerequisites` was a FLAG name, not a quest id - QuestManager reads that list as completed QUEST ids, so this quest was never available and the ladder was dead from mage_02 down. Moved to `flag_prerequisites`, which is the list of flags that is actually checked; the flag itself is raised by the previous quest's on_complete_flags.
